method: Post-hoc scan of all prose chunks in the three character strategies. Count a boundary when non-whitespace source text remains in the same paragraph; flag it if the chunk does not end in ., ! or ?. Preserve source positions and adjacent excerpts. No tokenization or embedding call.
limitations: Punctuation heuristic, not complete linguistic segmentation; terminal dots may be abbreviations.
Does not audit source paragraph boundaries, cross-sentence dependencies or all domain term boundaries.
No changes to frozen query labels, primary experimental scores or production chunking.
